title: Sensory Saturdays
description:
Join us for Sensory Saturday, a special sensory-friendly event at FloridaRAMA designed to provide a calming, enjoyable experience for individuals with sensory sensitivities.
During this time, we’ll adjust the environment to create a more accessible and inclusive atmosphere, with reduced noise levels, dimmed lighting, and quieter interactions.
This event is perfect for sensory seekers, families, and individuals on the autism spectrum who may find the high-sensory nature of our immersive exhibits overwhelming.
We’ll also have sensory kits available for guests to borrow, as well as designated quiet areas to provide a peaceful retreat when needed.
What's included
Admission is INCLUDED with purchase of each Sensory Saturday ticket!
Sensory kits are included upon arrival

title: Craft Night with the Girls Who Get It
description:
Join The Girls Who Get It and FloridaRAMA for Craft Night! Participants will design and take home a custom set of two mosaic coasters using colorful glass tiles. This quick-drying, fun project suitable for all skill levels. In addition to crafting your coasters, you can mix up a drink at the Dirty Soda Bar with your favorite syrups and creamers, then treat yourself to a custom bag of popcorn packed with sweet and savory toppings.
Every ticket includes all craft supplies, food and drink perks, as well as general admission to explore the museum before or after the event.
What's included
Craft Supplies
Food & Drinks Perks
FloridaRAMA Admission

title: Halloween Toddler Rave
description: Get ready for a Halloween Toddler Rave at FloridaRAMA with The Mom Walk Collective St. Pete! Bring your little ones for a fun-filled celebration with music, dancing and Halloween magic. Explore local vendors, connect with other families and let your toddlers dance the day away in a festive, family-friendly atmosphere!

title: FloridaRAMA Fest: Mobile Museum Unveiling, Diorama Trail & Art Fair
description: On Saturday, November 14th, celebrate FloridaRAMA’s 5th Anniversary and the launch of a new mini FloridaRAMA experience inside a bespoke Airstream trailer. The day will include the premier of newly commissioned dioramas, diorama contest winner announcements, an art fair and a new FloridaRAMA call for digital art!
